correctness.rationale: The sine basis gives a simple spectrum and exact monitored-node zeros via Bézout gcd. The dissipative Hilbert–Schmidt identity forces every peripheral eigenoperator to commute with the site projectors; stationary bright coefficients collapse to a common scalar and nonstationary bright entries vanish by nilpotence and row/column sparsity. Contractivity removes imaginary-axis Jordan blocks and yields exponentially decaying complement. An exact root-of-unity sum produces the full normalized Cesàro kernel and all endpoint regimes. Numerical full-superoperator diagonalization agreed in 83 monitor sets and 461 site starts for sizes 2 through 7; these finite tests are not used as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The general DFS noise-eigenvector condition is prior knowledge (Lidar–Whaley 2003) and all-site dephasing classicalization on cycles and other graphs is prior knowledge (Solenov–Fedichkin 2005; Bressanini–Benedetti–Paris 2022). The inspected primary results do not state a necessary-and-sufficient gcd placement criterion for every monitored subset of a finite adjacency path, the full asymptotic operator decomposition for arbitrary initial states, and the exact residue-dependent Cesàro site kernel. The distinction is one of hypotheses and implication, not an unmatched title. A specialized earlier treatment remains a nonzero priority risk.
residual_risks: A specialized older paper could have derived the same finite-path invariant asymptotics under different dephasing or controllability terminology; search non-detection does not certify priority.

General decoherence-free-subspace theory subsumes the qualitative *mechanism*; originality depends on the complete exact arithmetic and asymptotic-probability package, not the mere observation that noise-dark modes survive.
Finite-graph models with Laplacian rather than adjacency Hamiltonians may have different protected spectra; careless comparison of their results could be misleading.

value.rationale: Selective local monitoring poses a natural engineering and mathematical question: does noise destroy all quantum-path memory? The exact gcd criterion provides a necessary-and-sufficient answer for every monitoring placement, including a dramatic endpoint-versus-midpoint difference, and the operator-level asymptotic decomposition plus residue-dependent Cesàro matrix supplies explicit observables beyond qualitative DFS existence. This is a natural complete classification and rate-independent transport invariant, not a textbook change of notation or an arbitrary small finite slice. Its limitations and overlap with general DFS theory are explicitly acknowledged.
